data.title: Bitcoin Fell to $71,800 After Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigned. Is That Why BTC Hit Its Lowest Price Since August?
data.description: Bitcoin was already sliding for weeks when NVIDIA's CEO walked out the door. Between ETF outflows, shrinking stablecoin supply, and a surprising miner link to AI, the real culprit may be hiding in plain sight.
